final_task_success.source: Project operator final count supplied on 2026-11-13
final_task_success.definition: Operator-reported completed pick-and-place; no new video-based or timed-stability adjudication performed during this export.

logged_metrics.selection: Formal raw_policy execute records with TASK_SEQUENCE_FINISHED, task_sequence_complete=true, successful grasp and release, and no failed gripper action. Excludes prepare, return, debug records and archive copies.

trial_max_single_joint_tracking_error.label: 每条试次最大单关节跟踪误差

server_prediction_decode_trial_mean.label: 每条试次服务端预测时延均值

observation_to_candidate_ready_trial_mea.label: 每条试次观测到候选就绪时龄均值

measurement_definitions.tracking_mae: Absolute commanded-versus-measured position error, averaged over seven arm joints and saved state rows within each trial, then trial means weighted equally. Approximately 25 Hz plus event-triggered samples; not a full 1 kHz trace. Separate from offline prediction MAE.
measurement_definitions.controller_recorded_interval: Last minus first status.data[0] controller time; includes recorded waiting, execution and stopping, excludes earlier configuration and prechecks. Not a video-adjudicated task completion time.
measurement_definitions.server_prediction_decode: Server prediction and decoding; excludes camera capture, network upload and complete HTTP round trip. Saved startup and numbered replies, excluding preflight; candidates may not have been executed.
measurement_definitions.observation_to_candidate_ready: packet.ready_monotonic minus observation_monotonic; includes input age, transfer, inference and file writes, excludes subsequent wait for execution. Only archived valid packets are included.
unavailable_metrics: Separately measured cumulative policy waiting time
Independently adjudicated complete physical task duration
Aggregate motion/latency metrics for all 40 successful trials
A complete per-trial outcome ledger for all 50 attempts

source.redactions: Original machine-absolute report.json hyperlinks replaced by plain trial IDs; source document values unchanged. A scope note was prepended.
source.csv_precision: CSV rows were transcribed from the rounded Markdown tables, not original per-trial JSON/CSV files. Reported aggregate values retain the source report precision; tiny differences when recomputing from rounded rows are expected.

comparison_scope: Real-world results are separate from the LIBERO/MuJoCo simulation evaluation. No matched real-world baseline is supplied in this update.
